rules: A SKIP stands only when its profile has an entry with its module and check whose reason_contains is in the skip's reason. Any other SKIP is a FAIL, declared or not.
Every check in `checks` must be registered and every registered check must be here; a difference is a FAIL.
A skip never counts as a pass. A skipped core workflow cannot earn readiness (plan of record, section 1).
Adding an entry is a release decision: change the matrix in the same commit and say why.

Profiles combine: --skip-profile staging,ai-disabled permits the entries of both. ai-disabled is for a host installed with tn_ai_enabled: false and is added by install/playbooks/acceptance.yml only then.
Amended 2026-10-20 (#192, owner-approved): seven checks added to existing modules; see `amendments` and the matrix's dated amendment. The frozen rc4 entries are unchanged.

staging.reason_contains: it needs a writable, real vCenter
staging.reason: Building a lab clones VMs from a content-library template and waits for VMware Tools. Staging's vCenter is the read-only simulator (tn-vcenter-sim); there is no writable vCenter.
staging.alternative_evidence: tests/integration/test_lab_sessions_vsphere.py through .github/workflows/lab.yml (self-hosted runner, not yet registered: no run exists). On staging, 'lab session refusals' covers access control only.

staging.reason_contains: it needs a provisioned range on a writable hypervisor
staging.reason: A real deploy installs the noise agent on built range VMs (deploy_noise_agents on worker-provision). Staging provisions nothing.
staging.alternative_evidence: tests/integration/test_noise_flow.py and tests/worker/test_noise_inventory_safety.py (CI). On staging, 'profile, dry-run deploy, plan, stop' covers planning and control.

staging.reason_contains: it needs a provisioned range on a writable vCenter
staging.reason: so-setup runs per range on a built securityonion VM over VMware guest operations (ADR 0012 decision 8). Staging provisions nothing; its vCenter is the read-only simulator.
staging.alternative_evidence: tests/worker/test_vsphere_securityonion.py and tests/worker/test_setup_reconcile.py (the reconcile task that records the setup's outcome, #216) (U: every answer so-setup reads is checked, the runner patch, status polling). End to end: ADR 0012 decision 10, SOC Analyst built on the work vCenter with Security Onion seeing the mirrored traffic.

ai-disabled.check: AI orchestrator answers through the API
ai-disabled.reason: The host was installed with tn_ai_enabled: false (no AI server yet). The check SKIPs only when TN_AI_ENABLED=false, deep health reports the orchestrator's ai_configured: false, and POST /ai/detection-draft answers 503 'AI is not configured'; any disagreement is a FAIL.
ai-disabled.alternative_evidence: tests/ai_orchestrator/test_not_configured.py, tests/ai_orchestrator/test_api_ai_not_configured.py, tests/contracts/test_installer_ai_optional.py; the same check is mandatory on any host with AI enabled.

ai-disabled.reason: With AI disabled, ARC² runs only with a model of its own (preflight); a host with neither has the Studio off and acceptance.yml declares arc2 absent.
ai-disabled.alternative_evidence: Mandatory in the staging profile (ARC2_STUDIO_ENABLED=true there).

ci-integration.check: audit export: latest signed, chained, verifiable
ci-integration.reason: The CI integration stack is minutes old: no audit row is older than yesterday, so there is no finished day to export (and its worker has no AUDIT_SIGNING_SEED). The check SKIPs only when audit_exports is empty and the oldest audit row is from yesterday or today; an empty table with older rows is a FAIL.
ci-integration.alternative_evidence: Mandatory in the staging profile (the installer exports at 99-validate; the archive is mounted read-only, --audit-archive); tests/worker/test_audit_tasks.py; tests/scripts/test_staging_acceptance.py verifies the check against a signed archive.
